title: Claude API 2026-10-21: Fix Breaking Requests - AI Daily Diff Oct 22
closing_line: Audit representative requests in staging before changing the SDK major version or API header in production.

items.headline: Audit request shapes before adopting Claude API version 2026-10-21.
items.what_changed: Anthropic released a new API version and SDK majors that send it by default.
items.why_it_matters: Previously accepted Messages requests can now fail with 400 errors after an upgrade.
items.who_should_care: Builders maintaining Claude Messages API clients, batches or gateways.

diff.minus: Older clients may send sampling controls, assistant documents or user-supplied citations.
diff.plus: The new version removes those request shapes and documents replacement behavior.

items.watch_out: Bedrock supports this API version only with Claude 4.7 or later. We did not call the API live.

walkthrough.use_case: Proposed staging audit for an existing Messages API client before upgrading its Claude SDK major version or anthropic-version header.
walkthrough.steps:
Capture representative single-message, multi-turn, document, citation and batch request fixtures.
Remove temperature, top_p and top_k because the new version rejects them.
Move direct document blocks out of assistant messages and remove citations from user text blocks.
Update code that reads renamed Admin API or Enterprise Analytics fields.
Send the revised fixtures to staging with anthropic-version 2026-10-21 and verify success, error handling and response parsing before production rollout.
walkthrough.availability: Available now through the Claude API and current SDK majors. Direct HTTP callers set anthropic-version: 2026-10-21. Bedrock requires Claude 4.7 or later.
walkthrough.limitations: Documented migration plan only. No SDK was installed and no live Claude API, batch, Bedrock or production reliability test was run.
walkthrough.evidence_label: Official release notes and migration guide reviewed; no live API test.

youtube_description:
Claude API version 2026-10-21 was released on October 21 with new SDK major versions and documented request-breaking changes. This builder briefing shows how to audit representative Messages API fixtures before changing the anthropic-version header or upgrading a client library.

- Remove temperature, top_p and top_k, which now produce 400 errors.
- Move direct document blocks out of assistant messages.
- Remove citations attached to user text blocks.
- Update renamed Admin API and Enterprise Analytics response fields.
- Run single-message, multi-turn, document, citation and batch fixtures in staging before production rollout.

This is a source-based migration walkthrough, not a live Claude API, SDK, Bedrock or reliability test. Amazon Bedrock supports this API version only for Claude 4.7 and later. Follow AI Daily Diff for verified technical AI changes and practical implementation decisions.
